text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap...!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
『Congratulations!』
『Wooo!』『Great win!』
『That was an amazing race!』

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Everyone...
Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Amidst the fierce yet warm applause of the local crowd, I clap with all my might. Here, in a land so far from Japan, the girl who seized a glorious victory is—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
My heartfelt gratitude for all of your prayers...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bathed in a light more dazzling than ever...
she radiated a majestic presence. It seemed she had ascended
yet another step in stature as a saint—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Once the lively post-race hustle calmed down and Red Desire was finally able to relax—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, thank you. But Vodka,
you don't have to start every conversation
with 'congratulations,' you know?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right, a souvenir for Vodka!
I just thought of something wonderful, so look forward to it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Well then, see you...—Fufu, of course.
I'll be sure to return safely along with the charm.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry to keep you waiting.
choice_data_list: The phone's been ringing off the hook day after day, huh.
The phone's been ringing off the hook day after day, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Vodka-san, Buena-san... and everyone else too.
They've shown me so much kindness and care...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it cannot be helped.
The fact that I am a great saint
is now an undeniable truth...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A local Umamusume asked me earlier
to offer a prayer for victory as well...
Ah, I'm so busy♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right after the race, Red Desire had displayed a breathtaking majesty... but now she was completely back to her usual self.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Now's our chance while the phone isn't ringing!
Let's go buy souvenirs!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
A glowing Western sword is pretty hard to come by, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I feel like tourist spots like this in Japan
usually sell glowing toy swords, but...
choice_data_list: Want to try looking for a different one?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No! This, too, is a trial bestowed upon a saint...
I will surely see it through!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her determination to face trials head-on hadn't changed either.
Since she had just overcome an extraordinary ordeal, I thought she might want to rest a bit—
choice_data_list: How about taking a break while you're in America?
How about taking a break while you're in America?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No, I shall keep building them up.
For I am... still here, after all.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I was able to grant them hope.
That victory has elevated my saintly power to new heights...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why! To ensure that the power within me is not lost, even more trials must be bestowed upon me!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Because I can overcome even that.
With who I am now, having cleared that special trial!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At first glance, she may look just like her usual self... but clad in
the radiance—the confidence—gained from this victory,
she pushes forward even more powerfully. Toward her dream...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, are you prepared as well?
What lies ahead is full of hardships and trials...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The second chapter of a story that reached a grand, happy conclusion
often tends to have quite a sharp, edgy beginning.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However, as long as it is us, there is no problem at all.
—After all, we have the blessing of the land of liberty!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that sparkle in your eyes, brimming with confidence...!
You too are steadily making progress... fufu."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Right now, I shall surely find it! —A cursed sword, glowing, raging, and bound with sealed demonic power...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, look over there! That shop
has a white cloth hanging outside.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Surely they must keep holy water and crystals
used by American saints here!
Trainer-san...!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The Saint's journey never ends. Clad in light with every trial overcome—she presses forward to where she longs to be."
